manifest.name: dsh-vision
manifest.description: DSH vision plugin: image recognition (Codex + Zhipu fallback) and generation (GPT Image + CogView fallback), text-only-model safe

bundle.text:
# dsh-vision bundle layer: mount the plugin rows when a profile lists this
# bundle. Applied after the profile's other bundles, before the profile's
# own cordis.patch.yml.
- insert:
    - id: vision
      name: dsh-vision

readme.text:
DSH (DeepSeek Harness) vision plugin: image **recognition** and **generation**
for text-only models, with a multi-engine failover chain and full UI
integration.

Built for personal use — engines ride what you already have (your logged-in
Codex / ChatGPT account), with free Zhipu and optional Gemini fallbacks.
Every engine parameter is editable in the harness Settings page, and all
temporary data is delete-after-use (用完即焚).

| Tool | What it does | Engine chain |
|---|---|---|
| `describe_image` | Read a local image, return a description. Default mode is **structured** (JSON evidence: description + OCR lines with pixel boxes + layout regions + entities); the agent integrates it into a natural-language answer. `mode: text` for plain description only | Codex → Gemini → Zhipu GLM |
| `generate_image` | Generate an image from a prompt; shown inline in the conversation (produced-file card + lightbox + download + reveal in Finder). `quality`: auto (Nano Banana 2 Lite, cheapest) / hd (Nano Banana Pro 1K/2K) / 4k (Nano Banana Pro 4K) | Codex (GPT Image) → Gemini Nano Banana (paid key) → Zhipu CogView |

The GUI blocks image paste for text-only models. This plugin intercepts
paste and drag at the window level, uploads the image to
`~/.dsh/generated-images/uploads/` (content-addressed: identical images are
stored once), and inserts the **file path as text** into the composer — the
model only ever sees text. A thumbnail rail above the input shows the images
(preview, horizontal scroll, per-image delete that also removes the path
from the draft). After sending, the images are injected back into the
conversation beside your user message.

- Every Codex call runs `--ephemeral` (no session files in `~/.codex/sessions`)
  with `--sandbox workspace-write`.
- Generated images: `gen-<hash>-<内容>-<引擎>.<ext>` + a `.meta.json`
  sidecar (engine label for the caption). The old plain-hash path is kept as
  a symlink so historical images keep working.
- Uploads: deduplicated by content hash; auto-cleaned after
  `uploadRetentionDays` (default 7, 0 = never); orphan `.meta.json` sidecars
  are cleaned automatically.
- Existing `~/.codex` data is never touched.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `codexPath` | auto | Codex CLI path (blank = auto-detect) |
| `uploadRetentionDays` | 7 | Upload retention (0 = keep forever) |
| `describeEngines` | `["codex","gemini","zhipu"]` | Recognition chain order |
| `generateEngines` | `["codex","gemini","zhipu"]` | Generation chain order |
| `engines.codex.*` | `gpt-5.6-luna` / `max` / `priority` | Codex model, effort, speed tier, timeout |
| `engines.gemini.*` | aliases + Nano Banana models | Gemini describe chain + generation models |
| `engines.zhipu.*` | `glm-4.6v-flash` / `cogview-3-flash` | Zhipu models, size, timeout |

- `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` — DeepSeek (harness)
- `GEMINI_API_KEY` — Gemini recognition (free tier; Pro degrades to Flash)
- `GEMINI_IMAGE_API_KEY` — **generation only**, paid, separate project
- `ZHIPU_API_KEY` — Zhipu fallback (free)

Engines live in the `ENGINES` registry in `lib/index.js`:

```js
const ENGINES = {
  codex: { id, label, describe(bytes, cfg, prompt, signal, runtime), generate(prompt, cfg, signal, runtime) },
  gemini: { ... },
  zhipu: { ... },

Add = one registry entry + one settings config object + a default. Remove =
delete those. Chain order and per-engine params are editable in Settings.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-vision
```

Then restart `dsh web`. Add keys to `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` for the
fallback engines.

- Node.js with the DSH harness (`dsh web`)
- Codex CLI (npm: `@openai/codex`) logged in with a ChatGPT account
- Optional: Zhipu / Gemini keys for fallback engines
